commitment_versions_per_unit_fields.name: commitment_versions_per_unit_fields
commitment_versions_per_unit_fields.value: "app"."commitment_versions"."pricing" <> 'per_unit' or ("app"."commitment_versions"."unit" is not null and "app"."commitment_versions"."unit_price_inr" is not null and "app"."commitment_versions"."quantity" is not null)

events_end_after_start.name: events_end_after_start
events_end_after_start.value: "app"."events"."start_time" is null or "app"."events"."end_time" is null or "app"."events"."end_time" > "app"."events"."start_time"

quotes_per_unit_fields.name: quotes_per_unit_fields
quotes_per_unit_fields.value: "app"."quotes"."pricing" <> 'per_unit' or ("app"."quotes"."unit" is not null and "app"."quotes"."unit_price_inr" is not null and "app"."quotes"."quantity" is not null)
